About this data. This is the official AITA junior national ranking list dated 22nd June, 2026, sourced directly from AITA's published PDFs for Boys and Girls U-14 and U-16, and covers the full published list in each category.

This page does not update itself. It's a static file with a snapshot baked in — AITA doesn't offer a public feed a page like this could poll automatically, and there's no server behind this page to check for changes on a schedule. When you want current numbers, just come back and ask for a refresh; the whole pull-and-rebuild only takes one conversation.

Three ways to search: a full or partial name (pick from the dropdown), an AITA registration number, or just a rank number (like "42") to see who currently holds that spot.

About the Compare tab's commentary: the "matchup preview" is generated from each player's current rank and points gap only. AITA doesn't publish match history, head-to-head records, or a ranking archive, so this tool has no way to know how two players have actually fared against each other in the past — the preview is a read of today's standing, not a prediction backed by real results.

For the live, always-current list, see aitatennis.com/playerranking.
